name: The Clash

whyMatters.en: London punk band that widened UK punk into reggae, rockabilly, and album-length politics; London Calling (1979) is the double-album hinge.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦朋克：把英国朋克拓宽到雷鬼、rockabilly 与专辑尺度政治；London Calling（1979）是双专铰链。

essentialTracks.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go

scenes.track: Should I Stay or Should I Go

note.zh: Combat Rock 电台钩子出口。

lyricQuotes: London calling to the faraway towns

shortBio.en: Strummer / Jones punk-to-post-punk; London Calling is the mass document.
shortBio.zh: Strummer / Jones 从朋克到后朋克；London Calling 是大众文献。

body.en:
Formed 1976. Early CBS singles and The Clash debut are fast punk; Give ’Em Enough Rope and London Calling expand styles; Sandinista! overshoots length; Combat Rock yields radio hits.

London Calling (1979) and Should I Stay or Should I Go / Straight to Hell (1982) show range. Longer fuse than the Pistols.
body.zh:
1976 年组建。早期 CBS 单曲与首专是快朋克；Give ’Em Enough Rope 与 London Calling 扩展风格；Sandinista! 时长过载；Combat Rock 交出电台热单。

London Calling（1979）与 Should I Stay or Should I Go / Straight to Hell（1982）展示幅度。引信长过 Pistols。

title.zh: 把朋克当可扩展工具箱

body.en:
The Clash matter because they treat punk energy as a base layer under reggae riddims, piano rockers, and reportage lyrics—not a purity test.

Album ambition inside a punk generation.
body.zh:
The Clash 要紧，因为他们把朋克能量当雷鬼 riddim、钢琴摇滚与报道歌词下的底层——而非纯度测验。

朋克一代内部的专辑野心。

body.en:
Strummer vocal, Jones guitar, Topper drums—opening statement of the 1979 double album.

Scene + songcraft fused.
body.zh:
Strummer 人声、Jones 吉他、Topper 鼓——1979 双专开场声明。

场景与歌曲工艺融合。

title.en: Should I Stay: rock’n’roll hook export
title.zh: Should I Stay：摇滚钩子出口

body.en:
Simple chord cycle, gang vocal—Combat Rock radio object that outlives scene politics for casual listeners.

Exportable craft beside the experimental tracks.
body.zh:
简单和弦循环、群吼——让休闲听众记过场景政治的 Combat Rock 电台对象。

实验曲旁的可导出工艺。

body.en:
Later political punk and indie cite the permission to mix styles. DNA is curiosity under urgency, not a single tempo.

Jones vs Strummer tensions are documented personnel history.
body.zh:
后来政治朋克与 indie 引用其混搭风格许可。DNA 是紧迫下的好奇，而非单一速度。

Jones 与 Strummer 张力属有文献的人事史。

body.en:
Interview slogans about boredom and engagement match the lyric reportage.

Check them against the records’ stylistic spread.
body.zh:
关于无聊与介入的访谈口号，与歌词报道匹配。

对照唱片的风格跨度核验。

note.en: Punk grows up without losing urgency.
World music curiosity inside three-chord politics.
note.zh: 三和弦政治里塞进世界音乐好奇。
